configuration.methodology: Frozen before final evaluation. No training, threshold selection on held-out outcomes, or official benchmark label. Transfer prior stress is not a simulated measured GPU latency.

profile_priors.meaning: Conservative measured profile-cost gate; no quality-benefit prediction claimed.

baseline_labels.history: survivor-only history heuristic, not H2O reproduction
baseline_labels.query: cached coordinate-bound heuristic, Quest inspired, not faithful Quest
baseline_labels.window: pure window; zero sink/prompt protection, separate protection stratum
baseline_labels.sinks_recent: identical to protected recency under common prompt=sink=8; explicit alias
baseline_labels.deterministic/recovery: existing Phase 4 deterministic archive routing, not trained scoring
baseline_labels.cost/recovery: existing query recovery gated by independently measured scoring/copy prior
baseline_labels.conditional: current-query cosine change and fixed interval; first selection scored
baseline_labels.calibrated: validation-selected existing candidate, not a new trained network

resource_comparison: All core bounded arms four pages x eight tokens, common prompt/sink/recent=8 except pure window. Archive/index and exact-prefix storage extra. Full unbounded comparator.
unexecuted_components: Adaptive page budgets do not exist; fixed budget sensitivity only.
Feature-cache recomputation ablation is a single-thread diagnostic hook; no dense-current-attention feature baseline.
No faithful published-method reproduction, batched sparse serving, disk archive, GPU recovery, natural low-mass mining, or Phase 6.
statistics: Per-example/session paired bootstrap, seeds averaged within group; tiny exploratory sample.
timing: CPU perf_counter, four Torch threads, batch=1 concurrency=1. Quality trials reuse common measured prefill fixture, not end-to-end timings. Separate systems repeats perform actual cold/warm requests.
